notes: The jussive frame *Let … appoint* belongs to the verb whose mood it renders and is discontinuous around the long subject phrase (rules 17, 25); *Let* is not `added`, and the head stays on the lexical predicate.
הָרוּחֹת is rendered arthrously, so the article takes the *the* before its own word and אֱלֹהֵי a supplied one (rule 29).
